name: Context Forcing
model_version: Context Forcing model.pt (generator_ema; chunk-wise AR, 4-step contextual DMD from a long-context teacher, sink + slow / fast KV memory, no CFG) on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B; code TIGER-AI-Lab/Context-Forcing@6dd9d9a88332

weights.repo: ShuoChen20/context_forcing@d44ae93b (model.pt) + Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B (umT5-XXL text encoder, Wan2.1 VAE, DiT config)

notes: Text-to-video only: an opening image cannot be given, so the image + text (i2v) track is not registered. 832x480 at 16 fps, 3-latent (12-frame) causal blocks generated live with the upstream context_dmd_inference.yaml settings (4 DMD steps 1000/750/500/250, warped, shift 5.0; 21-latent KV cache = 3-latent sink + similarity-selected slow memory + 6-latent fast window, RoPE anchored within 21 latents, so long sessions use the model's own context memory). It has no prompt-switch mechanism: the block prompt '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>' is re-encoded and the cross-attention cache reset at the next block; camera_control text is given as prompt text because the model has no camera input.
